Market today: The mood is cautious for tech. Despite weaker jobs data, bond yields are ticking higher, suggesting inflation concerns or a hawkish Fed outlook persists. This is the real driver, as higher yields pressure your growth-oriented tech and chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-27.16%) and SPAL (-24.89%) are flashing red with "SELL" statuses and significant losses. These leveraged ETFs decay and are amplified by margin, demanding immediate attention. SMH is also slightly down (-0.91%).

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. Continued upward movement will likely put more pressure on your tech book. Also, monitor your leveraged holdings for further decay.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged losers, as market signals suggest continued pressure on growth stocks.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL and SPAL given their "SELL" status, deep losses, and leveraged nature, especially with margin amplifying drawdowns.
Watch MUU (your holding, -0.24%) closely; the scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup (entry 37.06-37.03, stop 36.96), but be mindful of its leveraged nature.
CRWD is a strong winner (+54.37%) with a "BUY" scanner setup (entry 268.75-268.35, stop 267.45). Consider trimming some profit to reduce overall portfolio risk, or adding if conviction is high.
